verdict.rationale: Godot documents its own scriptable editor surface. EditorInterface covers saving and loading scenes and editing resources and objects, EditorScript runs custom in-editor code, and the official CLI with headless mode is reported for CI builds, exports and scripted editor automation. The evidence does not show a documented external control channel an agent can use to drive a live editor: EditorScript is run from a menu or shortcut, and there is no official MCP server. Missing for 10: documented headless invocation of editor scripts for node/property creation, an official external agent-facing control protocol, explicit CLI export/build command documentation in the pack, independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven editing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can drive the editor and project programmatically — create scenes and nodes, edit properties, trigger builds — through a documented scriptable interface
